world_frame.origin: inside corner at floor, at backsplash tile faces
world_frame.W1: sink wall: tile face y=0, room y>0; run L along +x, fronts +y
world_frame.W2: right wall: tile face x=0, room x>0; run R along +y, fronts +x

local_frame.convention: right-handed, Y-up, OBJ/glTF style: +X viewer's right facing the front, +Y up, +Z out of the front; component files are in local mm with the pivot at the origin

pivots.cabinet_slab_trim_backsplash_sink_refere: rear-bottom-left corner; geometry in X[0,w] Y[0,h] Z[0,d]
pivots.door: (hinge edge, bottom edge, FRONT face); left-hinged X[0,w], right-hinged X[-w,0]; Z[-t,0]; swing about local +Y, -110 deg left / +110 deg right (limited by door_swing.max_open_deg)
pivots.drawer_front: centre of back face; X[-w/2,w/2] Y[-h/2,h/2] Z[0,t]; slide local +Z
pivots.hardware_handle: centre of mounting footprint on the parent's actual front surface
